priceInterpretation.sourceDateMeaning: Publication date of the manufacturer announcement; not the web verification date and not automatically the first sale date.
priceInterpretation.reviewCompletedAtMeaning: Completion time of this bounded evidence review; it does not reset the age of the underlying prices.

referencePrice.sourceTitle: LG전자, 'LG 울트라기어' 게이밍 모니터, 세계 최초로 'IPS 패널'에 가장 빠른 응답속도(1ms) 갖추다
referencePrice.factSummary: LG's dated domestic announcement identifies 27GL850, states its Korean shipment price as KRW 799,000 and announces domestic sales beginning on August 12.

items.mappingLimits: The announcement names the domestic base model 27GL850. It does not establish that the catalog's global -B SKU and every Korean region suffix are the same exact retail SKU. Use as declared model-family launch reference only.

referencePrice.factSummary: LG's dated domestic announcement identifies 27GP950, states its Korean shipment price as KRW 1,090,000 and announces domestic release on May 3.

items.mappingLimits: The announcement names the domestic base model 27GP950. It does not prove exact retail equivalence to every global -B or Korean suffix. Use as declared model-family launch reference only.

referencePrice.factSummary: LG's dated announcement separately assigns a Korean shipment price of KRW 1,690,000 to 32GQ950. It announces sequential launches starting in Japan at month end but gives no exact first Korean sale date.

items.mappingLimits: Use the explicitly announced domestic price for the 32GQ950 model family. Do not treat May 25 as the first Korean sale date or claim exact equivalence to every -B/region retail SKU.

reuseStrategy: Store source basis, identity matching scope, original source date, source URL and verification time as separate fields.
Keep these declared domestic model-family launch prices distinct from current exact-SKU purchase quotes.
Display a launch reference label and original date, and apply the newly approved reference-price policy rather than pretending the source was freshly priced today.
Prefer a retained verified domestic product quote or declared launch price; where only an estimate is permitted, preserve its source basis and mark it as an estimate.
boundedResearchLimits: This file establishes three primary domestic manufacturer launch prices, not prices for every remaining product.
AMD's 2019 CPU announcement specifies USD SEP, so it cannot directly establish historical Korean retail KRW without a separate declared conversion basis.
A GPU chip or Founders Edition launch price cannot be represented as an exact MSI, Sapphire or other partner board selling price.
A seller page with a price but a different capacity, RAM kit count, PCB revision, used condition or overseas purchase basis requires the scope to remain explicit.
